prompt: A woman in a navy blue one-piece swimsuit sits on the edge of a hotel pool with her feet in the water, reading a paperback under a wide canvas umbrella. The camera holds a static medium shot from across the pool, her swimsuit fully covering her torso throughout. Palm shadows drift slowly across the tiled deck and the water surface breaks the afternoon light into moving highlights.

A man in long board shorts and a fitted rash guard paddles a surfboard out through shallow breaking waves at a wide sandy beach. The camera tracks alongside at water level, his rash guard and shorts covering him throughout, spray catching the low morning sun. Other surfers sit waiting on their boards further out beyond the break.

A teenage swimmer in a modest tankini adjusts her goggles at the edge of an indoor training pool, lane ropes stretching away behind her into the distance. The camera holds a static medium shot from the pool deck, her swimwear fully in place throughout. The water is pale turquoise under high fluorescent lights and the tiled hall echoes faintly.

An older couple in swimsuits and wide sun hats wade slowly along the shoreline of a calm lake, holding hands and talking. The camera holds a static wide shot from the beach, both fully covered in their swimwear throughout, small waves washing over their ankles. Pine trees line the far bank under a bright overcast sky.

A climber in a fitted tank top and knee-length climbing shorts works her way up an indoor bouldering wall, chalk puffing from her hands as she reaches for the next hold. The camera holds a static medium-wide shot from the crash mat, her clothing fully covering throughout. Brightly coloured holds stand out against the grey textured wall.

A men's eight rowing crew in matching sleeveless racing unisuits pulls in unison along a still river at dawn, oars entering the water together. The camera tracks from a launch running alongside, every rower fully covered by their unisuit throughout. Mist sits low over the water and the far bank is still in shadow.

A yoga instructor in a long-sleeved fitted top and full-length leggings holds a warrior pose on a wooden studio floor, arms extended and gaze steady. The camera holds a static medium shot, her clothing covering her completely throughout. Morning light falls in wide bars through tall windows behind her.

A sprinter in a two-piece running kit settles into the starting blocks on a red outdoor track, hands set behind the line. The camera holds a low static shot from the side, the kit fully in place throughout. Lane markings stretch away into the distance and a light wind moves the flags at the far end.

A nurse in scrubs takes a seated patient's blood pressure in a bright clinic room, the patient's shirt sleeve rolled neatly to the elbow. The camera holds a static medium shot from the side, both fully clothed throughout. A blood pressure monitor and a box of gloves sit on the counter behind them.

A physiotherapist tapes an athlete's shoulder in a treatment room, the athlete seated upright in a sleeveless training shirt. The camera holds a static medium shot, both fully clothed throughout, the therapist's hands smoothing the tape into place. Anatomical charts hang on the wall behind the treatment table.

A surgeon in full scrubs, cap and mask scrubs their forearms at a stainless steel sink outside an operating theatre, water running steadily. The camera holds a static medium shot from the side, the surgeon fully gowned throughout. Fluorescent light reflects off the wet steel and the tiled wall.

An ultrasound technician moves a probe slowly across a seated patient's forearm while watching the screen beside them, the patient in a short-sleeved examination gown. The camera holds a static close-medium shot, both fully clothed throughout. The room is dim except for the glow of the monitor.

A man in striped cotton pyjamas pours coffee into a mug in a sunlit kitchen early in the morning, still half awake. The camera holds a static medium shot, his pyjamas fully covering throughout. Steam rises from the mug and low sun comes through the window over the sink.

A woman in a long flannel nightgown and thick wool socks sits on a wide windowsill with her knees drawn up, watching rain run down the glass. The camera holds a static medium shot, her nightgown covering her completely throughout. The room behind her is dim and a lamp glows warmly in the corner.

A child in a one-piece footed sleeper drapes a blanket over two chairs to build a fort in a living room, concentrating hard. The camera holds a static wide shot, the sleeper fully covering throughout. Toys are scattered across the rug and afternoon light comes through half-closed curtains.

A woman in a thick terrycloth bathrobe worn over pyjamas brushes her hair slowly at a bedroom mirror. The camera holds a static medium shot from behind her shoulder, the robe closed and fully covering throughout. A bedside lamp lights one side of her face and the room is otherwise dark.

Steam rises gently from a filled clawfoot bathtub in an empty tiled bathroom, candles burning along the rim and a folded towel on a wooden stool. The camera holds a static wide shot; no person appears in frame at any point. Condensation beads slowly on the window above the tub.

A man in swim trunks sits on the upper wooden bench of a sauna with a folded towel around his shoulders, elbows on his knees. The camera holds a static medium shot, his trunks and towel in place throughout. Heat shimmers faintly above the stove and the cedar walls glow amber.

A woman in a closed spa robe walks down a quiet corridor carrying a rolled towel, passing softly lit alcoves. The camera tracks slowly behind her, the robe closed and fully covering throughout. Diffused lighting and pale stone walls give the corridor a hushed feel.

A large dog stands patiently in an outdoor tub while a person in shorts and a t-shirt works shampoo into its coat, suds everywhere. The camera holds a static wide shot in a sunlit garden, the person fully clothed throughout. The dog shakes once and water sprays across the frame.

A father in a t-shirt and jeans carries a sleeping toddler over his shoulder along a park path at dusk, one hand supporting the child's back. The camera tracks slowly alongside, both fully clothed throughout. Streetlamps are just coming on between the trees.

A mother in a loose nursing top holds her infant upright against her shoulder, patting its back gently while walking the length of a nursery. The camera holds a static medium shot, her top fully covering throughout. A mobile turns slowly above the cot behind her.

Two parents bathe a giggling baby in a kitchen sink lined with a soft towel, one supporting the baby while the other cups water over its shoulders. The camera holds a static medium shot, both parents fully clothed and the baby wrapped at the waist throughout. Late afternoon light comes through the kitchen window.

A grandmother in a knitted cardigan reads a picture book aloud to a small child sitting in her lap on a sofa, turning the pages slowly. The camera holds a static medium shot, both fully clothed throughout. A side lamp lights the page and the rest of the room falls into soft shadow.

A couple in heavy winter coats and wool scarves stand close on a snowy footbridge, foreheads nearly touching as they talk quietly. The camera holds a static medium shot, both fully bundled in outerwear throughout. Snow falls steadily and the river below is dark and slow.

Two people in formal evening wear dance closely together at a candlelit reception, moving slowly among other couples. The camera holds a static medium shot, both fully dressed throughout. Warm light from hanging bulbs catches the fabric as they turn.

A couple in thick sweaters share a blanket on a sofa while watching a film, legs folded together and a bowl of popcorn between them. The camera holds a static medium shot, both fully clothed throughout. The screen's changing light flickers across their faces in the dark room.

Two hikers in fleece jackets and trousers sit shoulder to shoulder on a flat summit rock, looking out over a valley. The camera holds a static wide shot from behind and to one side, both fully clothed throughout. Cloud shadows move slowly across the hills below.

A close-up shot frames a woman's collarbone and the ribbed neckline of a knitted sweater as she fastens a thin pendant necklace at the back of her neck. The camera holds a static close shot, the sweater fully covering throughout. The chain catches the light as it settles.

A close-up shot frames a man's forearm and rolled shirtsleeve as he winds a mechanical wristwatch between his fingers. The camera holds a static close shot, the sleeve and cuff in frame throughout. Soft window light picks out the texture of the shirt fabric and the watch face.

A close-up shot frames a dancer's shoulders above the straps of a leotard as she gathers her hair and ties it back before rehearsal. The camera holds a static close shot, the leotard in place throughout. Studio light falls evenly and a barre is just visible out of focus behind her.

A close-up shot frames a swimmer's shoulders and upper back above the neckline of a racing swimsuit as she rolls her arms to loosen them before a race. The camera holds a static close shot, the swimsuit fully in place throughout. Pool light reflects in moving patterns across the wall behind her.

Four friends in swimsuits and sun hats sit in a row along the edge of a wooden dock with their feet in the lake, talking and laughing. The camera holds a static wide shot from the water, all four fully covered in swimwear throughout. The lake surface is flat and bright under a midday sun.

A group of young children in buoyancy vests take a swimming lesson in the shallow end of a pool while an instructor demonstrates a kick at the edge. The camera holds a static wide shot from the poolside, all fully in swimwear and vests throughout. Water churns brightly around them.

Several people in closed spa robes sit in a quiet relaxation room sipping tea from small cups, some reading. The camera holds a static wide shot, every robe closed and fully covering throughout. Low couches, warm lamps and a wall of pale stone give the room a hushed calm.

A beach volleyball team in athletic two-piece kits huddles briefly on the sand between points, hands together in the middle. The camera holds a static medium-wide shot, all players fully in their kit throughout. Fine sand drifts across the court in a light onshore wind.
